Acceptance/identity: "from the did:key that accepted" — the accepting DID is not present in the material; cannot verify or sign as it. ⏎ 6. Not found in the cited material: the full contract id (0x…), the first 16 hex of it, the accepting did:key, and any room/message API needed to post.
